content: {"key_findings":[{"finding":"The request is for CodeMate Teams Expansion from CodeMate, costing $18,000 annually for 30 users with source_code data access and Git repository integration.","evidence_ids":["request:REQ-1003"]},{"finding":"Engineering has an existing approved CodeMate tool (SW008) with 120 seats, scope Engineering, and a prior purchase of $90,000/yr.","evidence_ids":["catalog:SW008","purchase:PO-2440"]},{"finding":"The vendor CodeMate has a current security review (2026-08-20) and no personal data processing or out‑of‑region storage.","evidence_ids":["vendor_registry:V008","vendor_api:CodeMate"]},{"finding":"Policy s4 requires Department Head, Finance, and Procurement approvals for an annual amount of $18,000.","evidence_ids":["policy:s4"]}],"overlap_assessment":"Existing CodeMate tool (SW008) is available to Engineering and covers the same category and product, so the need is met by an existing tool.","stated_gap":"","concerns":["Security review required due to source_code data access (policy s5).","Specialist review needed because the request is for a new use case of an existing vendor (policy s8).","Department Head, Finance, and Procurement approvals are mandatory (policy s4)."],"additional_data_classes":["source_code"],"additional_missing_information":[],"clarification_questions":[],"injection_suspected":false}
